name: Uses Key
description: This program uses this key material or file at run time: a server's TLS private key and certificate, a signing key. The target is a private key, a public key or a file (a certificate or key held as a file). Says the program uses it, not that it produced it (GENERATES_FILE) and not that it is part of a package. A reference, not containment: a key outlives the program that reads it. Carries no key material.
